home_contenu_2: At Electrotech, we specialize in designing, manufacturing, and integrating high-quality electrical control panels for industrial automation. Founded in 1997, our Quebec-based company brings 27 years of expertise across multiple industries, delivering custom automation solutions that enhance efficiency, reliability, and safety. We are recognized for our excellence in industrial control and automation engineering, and we are committed to exceeding the expectations of our clients, partners, and employees with professionalism and integrity.

home_photos_1_description: At Electrotech, we design and program custom industrial automation systems tailored to each plant’s needs. With our expertise in PLC programming and control panel integration, we optimize production processes for greater efficiency, reliability, and safety.
home_photos_2_description: From sensors to PLCs to dashboards — we bring every part of your industrial system together into one smart, streamlined automation solution. Simplify your process, maximize your uptime.
home_photos_3_category: Reliable service to keep your systems running
home_photos_3_description: Our experts provide responsive support and preventative maintenance to ensure your systems run smoothly — minimizing downtime and extending equipment life.
home_photos_4_category: Built-in excellence from start to finish
home_photos_4_description: Our commitment to Total Quality means attention to detail in every step — from the first wire to final inspection. No shortcuts, no compromises.
home_photos_5_description: Designed and built to match your exact specifications, our electrical panels combine smart layout, robust wiring, and scalable control logic — all backed by industrial-grade reliability.
